dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to determine the nature of slope processes as well as their spatial and temporal variability. The period investigated covers up to the last glacial maximum but it is mostly focused on the last 1000 years. Furthermore, we investigated the influence of slope processes on the dynamics of farm occupation and abandonment.
dct_title_s: Slope dynamics in relation to climate change and human occupation on Flautafell mountain, North-East Iceland
